args.text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?

Gideon, your first report was at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug (UTC-5, the workspace time zone) in this channel. You wrote that both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.

While the kiosks were down, the guard wrote trailer numbers on a clipboard. That's the only thing the channel says he did in that window, and your 10:42 message is the only source for it.

At 11:03 Mateo posted that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. At 11:08 you posted that both lanes were working as of 11:07. So the clipboard period ran about 21 to 25 minutes, depending on whether you count to kiosk 1 or to both lanes.

In that window, Mateo reported six trucks waiting at the east gate at 10:44.
And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?

Ruth, it's ticket INC-4821. Gideon's 3 Aug, 11:08 AM message in this channel says he attached the status-page screenshot to it. That screenshot was for the status-page access problem he was still chasing. Mateo's account couldn't see the page, though his admin account could open Pemberline Dock. I can't see inside the ticket, so I can't confirm the attachment itself.

Ruth, the screenshot is on ticket INC-4821. I replied in the thread on your message with the details.

The source is Gideon's 3 Aug, 11:08 AM message in #inc-vtg-hartford, which says he attached the screenshot to that ticket. I can't open the ticket itself, so I can't confirm the attachment is there.
